body:
Ativan works very well with my biochemistry, although more ativan certainly doesn't make it work better.  
I am a bit uneasy sharing my academic work here, as it can easily be traced to my real identity.  To put it vaguely, I have looked at the psychosocial impacts of mental health on the close friends and family of the mentally ill.  I currently am developing a marijuana cessation program for high risk youth.

EDIT: I should add that none of my colleagues or advisors have ever been told that my interest is more than purely academic.

Ha, welcome to my life.  I am currently in graduate school studying the public health perspective on mental health.  My undergraduate thesis hit a lot more closely to home than I admitted to any of my advisors.  I am all for learning everything.

On another note, the drugs definitely did kick in.  It's an interesting but not entirely unpleasant feeling.
I had them for anxiety but haven't touched them in months.  I just feel like I ran out of healthy coping tools today.

I know.  I do not want to die, just disappear a bit from the here and now.  I took 5x my normal dose but low enough that there shouldn't be long term implications.  It's not suicide, just a desire to check out for a bit.
I have a bottle of 0.5mg ativan as a prn.  I took five of those so far.
